reviews.text: Enya was great with communicating and very accommodating with scheduling. She cared for my mini golden doodle wonderfully and sent updates with pictures and photos daily. I’d definitely ask her to look after my pet when boarding services are needed again. Highly recommend !

Aurora loved all the affection she received!

I'm grateful for the care and for sending me the videos and photos of my sweetie's stay.
I highly recommend it! Joaquim seemed to feel at home, received lots and lots of affection, and returned feeling great. I will host him again!
My little duo, Caetano and Cazuza, loved their stay!!
Great experience! They were super loving and took great care of my Lua 💕
My dog ​​spent two days with Enya and her partner, who kept me updated at all times. She was very well cared for and received lots of affection! I highly recommend them!
Excellent stay! My Spitz was very well taken care of! 👏👏👏 …
They did everything to meet Paçoca's needs (who is complicated and perfect lol)
My dog ​​was so happy at the hotel that when I went to pick him up, he didn't want to come home with me!

You can leave your pet there without fear!! Enya and her husband are AMAZING! My Bruce had a wonderful experience at Hotel dos Peludos, he was treated super well and they followed all our recommendations. I can only thank Enya for everything, I've become a fan! For sure, Bruce already has a permanent place to stay when he needs it!
My little girl was very well taken care of... Thank you so much ☺️☺️☺️☺️☺️

Enya is wonderful! My dog ​​is still in the socialization phase and she won him over right away! She sends lots of videos and put me at ease while I was traveling. It will be our regular hotel! Otávio loved it ❤️
I highly recommend them! Enya and her husband were super attentive to my dog ​​(Fred), they sent me videos and photos and made me feel very carefree during his stay!

I left my dog ​​at their boarding facility this weekend and had an excellent experience. From the first contact, the service was very attentive and helpful. Enya was extremely kind, answered all my questions, and showed great care and affection for my dog.

During his stay, I felt reassured knowing he was being well cared for. You can tell the work is done with dedication and love for animals.

I definitely recommend them to anyone who needs a reliable place to leave their pet. Thank you so much for all the care!
I really enjoyed the experience, they were very attentive, sent lots of photos and videos, and were always available. We loved it!

I left my dog ​​at the daycare/hotel and the experience was simply wonderful! You can feel the care and affection from the very first contact. My dog ​​came back happy, calm, and clearly well cared for. It has become my trusted place.

Enya is a sweetheart! She was also extremely quick in her communication, super attentive, punctual, and, on top of everything, sent several photos and videos of Athena during the adaptation day I booked with her. I felt relieved knowing that my little girl will be in good hands during Carnival.
Our puppy was very well taken care of by Enya! She played and had so much fun! I recommend leaving your pets with Enya!
We left our dog with Enia. She was treated with so much love and attention. Simply amazing. She sent videos and photos of Jade from the day. I highly recommend her.
Wonderful and attentive service, my dog ​​was very well taken care of! I highly recommend them.

We left Lolita with Enya and her husband to attend a two-day event, and it was the best choice we made for our senior poodle. Lolita was undergoing a week of routine checkups and received all the love and attention at the furry hotel.
We received videos, photos, and constant updates, which made us feel very reassured. In addition, even before leaving Lolita, Enya took the care to ask if we preferred to keep her away from other dogs, for her comfort, besides the care in collecting the information. We highly recommend them and will leave Lolita there again whenever needed.
An amazing experience in terms of attention, care, and affection. I wouldn't consider another place to take our pet.

Enya took great care of our puppy!!! She came home very happy!!! She felt very comfortable in the house and was treated very well!! We were even worried she wouldn't want to come back!!!!! We are very satisfied!!!!
Pedrinho (my border collie) was very well taken care of during those days with Enya. She sent many photos and videos, and I was certain that he was doing very well and was happy. I recommend her!

I loved the welcome. Enya and Felipe were wonderful with my baby. I left her in their care for almost 20 days. They took very good care of her, including the various restrictions she has due to pancreatitis, and they were also very understanding of my overprotective nature towards Izzy (always contacting me, sending photos, organizing my schedule, etc.)... I highly recommend them. I will certainly leave her with them again if needed.
Toddy was very well taken care of; she always sends photos and videos. We loved the care he received.
Simply wonderful!!! My daughter felt right at home!!! Thank you so much!!!
They were very friendly! They sent photos several times a day, and that really helps build trust!
Warm and loving welcome for our little puppy! Excellent experience! Thank you for everything!
It was amazing!! I received several photos and videos of my puppies and they were always very calm and happy. I felt at peace knowing they were being well cared for ❤️

Enya was incredibly helpful, sending photos and videos constantly and responding very quickly, which was a real plus, as it created peace of mind. The videos showed how loving they were during the stay.
They were very attentive and kept us updated on my dog's day. I recommend them.
I loved the service and care given to my pet Lola. They always kept us informed about her, and I felt confident and happy knowing she was in good hands. Thank you for your kindness.
My dogs loved their stay!!! I received videos and photos of them, it was great and they will definitely stay with them again.

I loved it, loved it, loved it! They were incredibly attentive and loving with my son and made me feel very comfortable by sending photos and videos several times a day. Caetano is super wary, but he felt at home with them and with his new friend Caio, who is also a guest there.
I will definitely board him there again. Now I have a trustworthy place to leave the love of my life! I highly recommend it! 💙

An excellent place to leave your pet in a safe and comfortable environment. Enya and her husband take good care of the animals as if they were their own. Cioccolata gets spoiled from all the affection and pampering she receives from the owners of Hotel dos Peludos. It's also a great socialization environment for the dogs — who are separated by size and/or temperament. I recommend it!
Excellent, the couple really loves animals. My pet was well treated. I highly recommend them; they are truly honest and courteous people.

I am so happy I came across hotel dos peludos! I needed a last-minute boarding for my dog while traveling and was so grateful she was able to take in little baby boy last minute. It's always nerve-racking to leave your fur baby with someone for the first time, but with all of the communication, videos, and photos poring in, my heart was immediately at ease. My dog was well taken care of and so loved-- I highly highly recommend them. I would in a heartbeat board him there again!! Thank you so much again for taking care of Mr. Kingsley!

Very happy with the care my pet received… Highly recommended
Thank you very much

Excellent! Enya takes care of pets like her own children. Mine were very well taken care of. She understands and enjoys the experience of being with pets. Plus, we can monitor them at any time. I plan to return and highly recommend her.
Enya was very caring with my golden retriever! I felt reassured knowing he was in good hands while I was traveling. I highly recommend her!
The owners are very attentive. They took great care of our Brie and sent us photos and videos of her every day.

It was the first time my dog ​​stayed at a hotel and it was great for both of us! I traveled for 6 days and she was looked after by Enya and Filipe. I received photos and videos every day and my dog ​​was very well cared for and happy! I recommend them! When I need to again, I know who to count on!
Very attentive, she kept us informed about our dog the whole time, very caring and attentive!
Excellent! They took great care of me, always sending photos and videos, and were super polite! I highly recommend them! 👍 …
She was extremely attentive, caring, and took great care of my pet!! I highly recommend her!
I highly recommend them, they are super attentive. I took my dog ​​there without a recommendation, and I was very happy with the service.

I highly recommend the Furry Hotel ❤️🥰
Our dog was treated with so much love and care. They are very attentive and constantly send us photos and videos, keeping us updated on our furry friend's stay.

Thank you for everything.

Amorinha was so happy during her stay at the hotel! She received so much affection and love, had great company, and had so much fun. I'm so grateful to Enya and her husband! I trust and recommend them 100%! Thank you ☺️

Enya was amazing!
She took the best care of our Rebecca!
She sent us messages throughout the day with photos and videos. I recommend her 100%!
I loved it!! The owners are super affectionate, and they kept sending me videos and photos of my puppy, Lua, who was so happy!! 🐶💕 …
Excellent! They are super attentive, my Maltese spent the whole day there and I received videos the entire time!! I highly recommend them.

I don't even know where to begin. This is the second time I've left my dogs at a pet boarding facility. The first time, I had a very traumatic experience and was very afraid to leave them again. But after finding the furry hotel, seeing the reviews, and talking to Enya, I decided to give it another chance, since I realized that Enya takes her work very seriously and with a lot of care. My dogs stayed six days at her and Filipe's house and were treated with a lot of love, attention, and pampering. Every day they sent me photos and videos of them. It was the first time I traveled one hundred percent safe and carefree. My dogs came home happy and loved the attention that Enya and Filipe gave them. I've already scheduled their return for January and I hope I can count on them for the next times I need them.

I want to express my sincere gratitude for all the care and affection shown to my beloved Billy and Bella.
I traveled from São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro and left them at the boarding facility for about 10 hours to give myself time to visit Christ the Redeemer. They were very comfortable, I received several photos and videos, and it was undoubtedly my best choice. Thank you until next time.
It was great, I had never left my pet with anyone before, they are very punctual, the environment is so humane, I've already become a regular customer. I highly recommend them!!!

The best possible experience, I left my Cristal with Enya and she simply loved the stay, as if she were in our home.
I highly recommend her, she sends you videos of your pet... very attentive.

I left my little one (7 months old) at the pet hotel for the first time, and after reading the comments here and following the hotel on Instagram, I felt super reassured.
But it was even better than I expected! Enya sent several videos and photos even before I got home. He looked like he was in a spa, he was so pampered. And the BEST PART was that he didn't want to leave, hahaha. He stood there in front of the gate. I think that says a lot about all the love he received! I will definitely leave him there again. ❤️

Enya and her husband were wonderful with our babies. Margarete and Akamaru were very happy with them.
Thank you for attending to us at the last minute. Super fair price and service full of affection. Thank you ❤️
They were wonderful! Now I can travel with peace of mind knowing that my little cashew nut is receiving love and being very well cared for.

It was extremely important for me to leave my baby in care.
I had an excellent experience from the first contact until the end of Mavie's stay.
I received real-time photos and information; my heart was aching to leave her, but then I felt relieved.
She played so much with Aunt Enya.

I highly recommend it and we will definitely be back.

Thank you, Enya, for so much care and love.
Amazing! I left my dog ​​in their care and he loved it. They kept me updated the whole time. I highly recommend them.
I highly recommend him. Enias is a wonderful person, attentive, helpful, and caring. My little dog Chico felt right at home. Thank you so much.

Great job. Nice person.
Thank you so much. I really appreciate her service.
Enya and Filipe were very attentive and took great care of Milo. He loved them, and we were very happy with the service. I highly recommend them!
